goal:
Andrea's Resort is a lakeside cabin property with a perfect 5.0 Google rating, a working online booking system and 37 strong photos on its website. What it does not have is visibility. There are only 20 reviews, 522 followers across Instagram and Facebook, and one social post every ten weeks.

Over the next 90 days the goal is to increase direct bookings by 50% and grow the social following past 1,000, by posting consistently, building a steady flow of new reviews, and making the resort easy to find in local search.

weeks.title: Week 1: Profiles and Pattern
actions: Rewrite the Instagram and Facebook bios and add the booking link
Decide the weekly posting pattern
Reply to all 20 existing Google reviews
checklist: Both bios say where the resort is and link to the booking page
Four story highlights are live
The weekly pattern is written down and shared
Every existing Google review has a reply

weeks.title: Week 2: A Month of Content
actions: Sort the website photos into three folders
Write 12 captions and schedule them
checklist: Three folders hold at least four photos each
12 posts are scheduled in Meta Business Suite

weeks.title: Week 3: First Reels and Review Link
actions: Publish the first two Reels
Turn on comment notifications and follow 50 local accounts
Create the Google review link
checklist: Two Reels are published
50 local accounts are followed
The review link is saved where the whole team can find it

weeks.title: Week 4: Review Requests Go Live
actions: Set up the review request email
Print and place QR cards in every cabin
Check Instagram insights and note the three best posts
checklist: The review request sends automatically three days after checkout
A QR card is in every cabin
The three best posts of the month are noted

weeks.title: Week 5: Google Profile
actions: Complete every section of the Google Business Profile
Upload ten new photos and publish the first Google Post
Reply to new reviews within 24 hours
checklist: Seasonal dates and check-in hours show on the profile
Ten new photos are live
The first Google Post is published

weeks.title: Week 6: Technical Basics
actions: Record the Search Console baseline
Shorten the homepage title and add headings
Brief the web developer on structured data
checklist: The baseline export is saved with a date in the file name
The homepage title is under 60 characters
The developer has confirmed a delivery date

weeks.title: Week 7: Listings and Book Now
actions: Audit existing listings
Claim the four priority listings
Brief the Book Now button
checklist: Every existing listing is recorded with its name, address and phone number
Apple Maps, Bing Places, Tripadvisor and the tourism office listings are claimed
The Book Now button is scheduled with the developer

weeks.title: Week 8: Booking Page
actions: Add rates, cabin types and the cancellation policy to the booking page
Write the Know Before You Go page
Keep posting three times a week
checklist: Rates and the cancellation policy show on the booking page
Know Before You Go is published and in the main menu

weeks.title: Week 9: Guest List
actions: Import past guests and send the permission email
Add the sign-up form to the footer
Publish the three-day itinerary
checklist: The permission email has been sent
The footer sign-up form is live
The first local guide is published

weeks.title: Week 10: Pre-arrival Email
actions: Build and switch on the pre-arrival email
Check local ranking for your three key phrases
checklist: The pre-arrival email sends automatically five days before arrival
This month's ranking positions are recorded

weeks.title: Week 11: Seasonal Email
actions: Send the seasonal availability email
Publish the second local guide
Share two recent reviews on social
checklist: The seasonal email has been sent to confirmed subscribers
The second local guide is published
Two reviews have been shared on social

weeks.title: Week 12: Review and Plan Ahead
actions: Compare followers, reviews, search clicks and direct bookings against the baseline
Write down what worked, what did not and what to repeat
Set a monthly routine for posts, review replies and Google Posts
checklist: The 90-day numbers are recorded beside the baseline
A monthly routine is written down and on the calendar
